items.title: ‘It is what it is’: Merck exec unruffled by ‘unfortunate’ leak of ESMO cancer vaccine data
items.description: Merck & Co. and Moderna always knew they would be making headlines in Madrid this week—just not in the way it happened.

items.title: ESMO: Lilly touts 79% ADC response rate in competitive ovarian cancer space
items.description: Eli Lilly has shared phase 1 data on an antibody-drug conjugate in platinum-sensitive ovarian cancer, shedding light on the company’s chances of competing for a market targeted by rivals including AbbVie and Genmab.

items.title: ESMO: GSK cancer R&D chief says mo-rez data ‘reinforces our belief’ in ADC as phase 3 push ramps up
items.description: GSK’s cancer R&D chief has suggested the latest slice of early-stage data on its B7-H4-directed antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) has “reinforce[d] our belief in the asset,” as the therapy races through a clutch of phase 3 studies.

items.title: Roche puts numbers behind phase 3 kidney disease win amid blockbuster ambitions
items.description: Roche's Genentech has put numbers behind its phase 3 success in IgA nephropathy (IgAN), reporting that antisense oligonucleotide sefaxersen reduced a key marker of kidney damage by 43.1% compared with placebo.

items.title: Gilead to pay $1.3B upfront for PepStar’s oral IL-23 challenger to J&J’s Icotyde
items.description: Gilead has struck a deal to acquire PepStar Therapeutics’ oral IL-23 receptor inhibitor program for $1.275 billion, positioning itself as a would-be challenger to Johnson & Johnson’s Icotyde across a range of inflammatory diseases.

items.title: ESMO: Boehringer builds case for late-phase rival to Amgen’s Imdelltra
items.description: Boehringer Ingelheim has shared data on its DLL3xCD3 T-cell engager, providing pointers to the prospects of a would-be rival to Amgen’s Imdelltra that entered phase 3 this year.

items.title: Bolt makes inflammation play with Prana reverse merger, $120M financing
items.description: Bolt Biotherapeutics is acquiring Prana Therapies in a stock-for-stock reverse merger backed by a $120 million financing to advance Prana’s lead antibody through multiple phase 2 trials in inflammatory diseases.

items.title: ESMO: Zentalis already dreaming of launch for WEE1 inhibitor after ‘great result’ in early-stage test
items.description: Zentalis Pharmaceuticals has pointed to the first overall survival (OS) analysis for azenosertib as proof that the oral WEE1 tyrosine kinase inhibitor can offer a convenient oral treatment for a tricky cancer.

items.title: STAT+: Highly anticipated Moderna-Merck melanoma cancer vaccine data arrived early
items.description: In data released at ESMO, the Moderna-Merck personalized mRNA cancer vaccine reduced recurrence-free survival and the time until distant metastasis occurred.

items.description: As the ESMO conference kicks off, Tango's pancreatic cancer combination shows striking promise and detailed data on Moderna and Merck's cancer vaccine is released early.

items.description: A new Treasury Department proposal would restrict U.S. investments in Chinese biotechs, but still allows licensing deals.

items.title: STAT+: Tango reports 82% tumor response rate in trial of combo therapy for advanced pancreatic cancer
items.description: An experimental drug combination led to tumor responses in 82% of patients with a certain type of advanced pancreatic cancer, Tango Therapeutics reported.
